## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a8d597fd94fc639ea03c934ff9fad9d72f2632b9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md + none

First review of this head. Earlier records on the same line, read: 6886866329 (FAIL at `99ff68df`) and 6887077906 (PASS at `16cb2bc7`), both on PR #33568, which merged as `6b1b8c12`. The whole line was re-read against `origin/main` `babd5d4a` (this PR's base and merge-base), not only the moved clause.

### ① Derived judgments

- File list: one path, the ADR-0150 file, +1/-1 against `main` (line 288, the 2026-11-13 addendum). `reviewFace` hits = that path. The diff holds no implementing file, so `+ none`. No remainder for the lane seat.
- Net change, by word diff: "a hot install-local install" becomes "a hot install-local install or upgrade (an upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves included, since the re-register withdraws the position the new version no longer ships)"; "a hot upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves and" leaves the next-restart list; "are" becomes "is". No other word of the line moves. The PR body's "no other sentence of the addendum and no ruling text changes" is right.
- Accept-set and public surface: none moves. No schema, no code, no generated output, no authorable key. Right.
- Governed surface: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H and waits for a GOVERNED_APPROVER, as the PR body says. Right.
- Check-runs on the head (49 when read): 25 success, 23 skipped, 1 in progress (Test Core 1/8), none failed. Green: Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint & Repo Gates and its eight Lint jobs (ESLint, PM dispatch-gates, docs & code guards, repo & tooling gates, CI release & engine gates, three scoped), TypeScript Type Check and its four jobs, Test Core (2/8), Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate. The one unfinished run is not a verdict yet: the landing still waits for it to finish green.

### ② Semver level

- `skip-changeset` is right: the diff is `docs/adr/**` only, which no published package ships. Check Changeset is green on the head.
- Clause-②: the claim (6884480897, branch `claude/project-thread-6cr30t`) carries `Clause-②: no`, and that is right: nothing authorable narrows or widens. The PR body carries no `Clause-②:` line; none is owed on a diff with no changeset, and the PR-body guards are green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 6889297872: `open_questions` empty, `out_of_scope_findings` empty.
- Dev flag "an upgrade through the runtime `POST /packages` install is not claimed either way (unmeasured)": answered, and leaving it out is right. That door never re-registers a body: it calls `protocolSvc.installPackage` or `registry.installPackage(manifest, 'authored', settings)` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` :2602, :2624), which writes the package row and its claims and registers no item, and its install body can carry no `positions` (`packages-reload-announce.test.ts` header: `ManifestSchema` declares no such key, refused 400). So no version through that door "no longer ships" a position, and the new parenthetical is correctly tied to install-local alone.
- Dev flag "#33546's disable and DELETE announcements are not claimed": answered in ④. The line says nothing about a withdrawal, and nothing those two announcements do contradicts it.
- PR body, "pinned by PR #33473's real-kernel test through install-local": upheld (④).
- Escalated to the seat, not a contract finding: the PR body says `Fixes #33301`, and PR #33642 (Refs #33301) is still open and a draft. Merging this PR closes the card again, as PR #33568 did (6889216860), while the seat's own reopen note says the card closes after both merge.

### ④ Design judgment

File judged: the ADR line, against `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts`, `security-plugin-start-hooks.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` and `engine-registration.ts`, and every `metadata:reloaded` announcer, read on `origin/main` `babd5d4a`. The announcers on `main` are six call sites and no more: install-local install (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` :6805) and uninstall (:3817), the artifact reload (`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` :1600), the per-item publish (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` :846), `announcePackageReload` (`packages.ts` :971) and publish-drafts (`packages.ts` :3391).

The changed clause:

- "a hot install-local ... upgrade (an upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves included, since the re-register withdraws the position the new version no longer ships) ... carried at once": holds for the package the announcement names. The door registers through the `manifest` service (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` :3140), which calls `registerApp` per body; `engine-registration.ts` :189-191 runs each body inside `SchemaRegistry.replacingPackageBody` (`registry.ts` :9179), which, when the package has a previous body registration, removes the item slots that body wrote and this one did not (`withdrawPackageBodyItemsNotShipped`) and releases the security-catalog claims the manifest no longer declares. A late body's positions live in the registry only (the manifest service bridges objects alone to the metadata service), so the catalog no longer lists the old name. The door then announces `app/ID` last (:3269), `positionRenameReloadScope` (:533) admits it, the old name has no current holder, and the claim is carried. Pinned on a real kernel through the real door: `marketplace-install-local-hot-resync.test.ts` :304 (PR #33473), v1 to v2, holder moved at once, control untouched, second identical install writes no holder row; and `position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts` :538. The carry's own module doc on `main` (:135-138) says the same.
- "an artifact reload that names only its file is carried at the next restart": holds. The file watcher announces `[src.path]` (`plugin.ts` :1076) and the HMR POST its caller's list, or the path when none is sent (:1025); a path is no scope, and the boot run judges every claim.
- Tried and not broken: an upgrade whose register is refused puts v1 back (`restoringOnRefusal`), so nothing is claimed for it ("hot"); v2 that keeps the old position and adds the new one is `still-declared`, which the line lists; a hot downgrade ships no claim, so "nothing is carried back" stands; an ADR-0005 overlay of the old position is left in its bare slot by `replacingPackageBody` (its own doc), which can only end in a refusal the line already names (a position still declares it, or the environment holds it). The last was read from the doc, not traced to the catalog.

The rest of the line, against `main` as it stands now:

- "at `kernel:bootstrapped`, and again on each later `metadata:reloaded` that names the position or its package as registered ... as the system, in every organization": holds (`security-plugin-start-hooks.ts` :395-415 and :490-492; `createPositionRenameCarryRuns` :816, a reload before the boot run or naming no scope reads nothing, :842).
- The refusals sentence: holds. `claimed-twice`, `still-declared`, `held-by-other`, `owned-by-other` and `switched-off` are judged as written (:624-657); the set is the one 6887077906 read.
- "over the claims of what the announcement names as registered (`app/ID` while the registry holds package `ID`, `position/NAME`)": holds (:533-555, :588-589).
- "the runtime `POST /packages` install": holds. `announcePackageReload` is called at :2808 after the registry write, on both answers.
- "a `PATCH /packages/:id/enable` that switches a disabled package on": holds (:2875, :2883, only when `wasDisabled`).
- "a per-item publish of a position", "the positions of a publish-drafts": hold (`objectql/src/plugin.ts` :841-846; `packages.ts` :3385-3391).
- "named in the log of the run (...) and never rewritten": holds (:675-679, `logPositionRenameCarry`).
- #33527 / PR #33546 (`c43bffdf`): the disable door (:2958, only when `wasEnabled`) and `DELETE /packages/:id` (:4224, only when the registry removed it) now announce `app/ID` too. A DELETE names a package the registry no longer holds, so it is no scope and nothing runs. A disable names a package the registry still holds, so the run judges that package's claims and refuses each `claimant-disabled` (:645-647); nothing moves. Neither makes a sentence of the line false; see nit 2 for what the disable adds to an omission.

Findings:

1. **should-fix** — "a hot install-local install or upgrade ... carried at once" is true only of the package the announcement names, and install-local names one id: `announceHotInstall(ctx, manifestId)` sends `changed: ['app/' + manifestId]` (:3269, :6805), where `manifestId` is the delivered artifact's own id (:2488). The same door installs multi-package artifacts: each `packages[]` entry registers under its own id (`objectql/src/plugin.ts` :1047; the door's own notes at :2566-2570 and :4732-4747), and :2569 says the artifact's own id "names no package unless one of them carries it". So for a `packages[]` artifact, a member whose id is not the artifact's id is never named, its claims are outside the reload scope (:588-589), and its holders wait for the next boot; when no member carries the artifact's id, `registry.getPackage` answers nothing, the scope is empty, and nothing of the artifact is carried at once. The rule the same sentence states just before the colon ("over the claims of what the announcement names as registered") is right and bounds the list, and the carry's module doc says "a package the announcement does not name" is carried at the next boot, so a careful reader is not misled about the mechanism. But the list item itself overclaims, and this diff rewrites that item and widens it from installs to upgrades. The overclaim on installs is inherited from PR #33568; neither earlier record read the bundle path. Fix, either of: (a) on this line, qualify the item, for example "a hot install-local install or upgrade, for the package the door announces (the artifact's own id; the other packages of a multi-package artifact are carried at the next restart)"; or (b) a code card that makes install-local announce every package id it delivered, after which the line is true as written. Either earns a delta review. Not a FAIL: the clause this PR moves is correct for the case it is accepted against, the PR replaces a sentence that is flatly false on `main` for every single-package upgrade, and the residue is narrower than what `main` says today.

2. **nit** — the disabled claimant is still not in the line. "An old name that no installed position holds and no ledger row records under another package is carried for its one claimant, whichever package that is" has the `claimant-disabled` exception (:645-647), and "carried at once" for the install doors is true only of a package that is enabled when announced: an install-local upgrade of a disabled package keeps it disabled (`installPackage` carries the row's lifecycle over), is announced, and is refused until the enable announces it. This is nit 1 of 6887077906, unchanged; since PR #33546 the disable door is one more announcement that reaches the same unlisted refusal. An omission the diff inherits. Accepted deviation, or folded into the fix of finding 1.

3. **nit** — carried over from 6887077906 nit 2, unchanged: `logPositionRenameCarry` does not repeat a warning byte-identical to one the run just before it said (:710), so "named in the log of the run" has that one exception on the reload path. No effect on the contract. Accepted deviation.

Read, not reviewed (outside the diff): on `main`, `packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts` :166-171 (and its `.describe()`, with the generated row in `content/docs/references/identity/position.mdx` :36) still lists the hot upgrade and the runtime install and enable routes under the next restart, and the carry's module doc :138-141 and `REFUSAL_SENTENCE['claimant-disabled']` (:688) still say the runtime routes do not announce and that the first boot after the enable carries. PR #33642 (open, draft, head `27a39b87`) corrects them. Until it lands, this ADR line and the spec describe disagree on `main`; that PR's text carries the same unqualified install-local claim as finding 1 and owes the same qualifier if route (a) is taken.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-6cr30t`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5mswnWm181XgYcCUag`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1bb25336ec432a8d7e64303fa10e6082cb205f56`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md + none

Delta review of record 6889382518 (PASS at `a8d597fd`, one should-fix, two nits). The delta `a8d597fd..1bb25336` is one commit on the same line (ADR-0150 :288). The whole changed line was re-read against `origin/main` `3c0033f9`; the merge-base is still `babd5d4a`, and none of the cited files moved between the two (the line numbers below are the ones round 1 read).

### ① Derived judgments

- File list: one path, the ADR-0150 file, +1/-1 against `main`. `reviewFace` hits = that path. No implementing file in the diff, so `+ none`. No remainder for the lane seat.
- The delta moves three things and no other word: (a) the refusals sentence gains "nor carries holders onto a claimant whose package is disabled (refused `claimant-disabled` until an enable announces the package)"; (b) the install-local item gains "for the package the door announces"; (c) the next-restart list gains "the other packages of a multi-package artifact, which install-local registers but does not name", and its verb goes back to "are". The PR body's FROM/TO states all three. Right.
- Accept-set and public surface: none moves. No schema, no code, no generated output. Right.
- Governed surface: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H and waits for a GOVERNED_APPROVER. Right.
- Check-runs on the head (46 when last read): 19 success, 22 skipped, 5 in progress, none failed. Green: Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards (both runs), Auto Label, filter, Lint ESLint, Lint PM dispatch-gates, Lint docs & code guards, Lint repo & tooling gates, the three scoped Lint jobs, Type Check source gates, Plan Test Core shards, Test Core (2/8), Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate. Still running: Lint CI, release & engine gates; Type Check workspace, consumer gates and debt ledger; Test Core (1/8). Both Check Changeset runs are skipped on this head (the PR carries `skip-changeset`), not green as on `a8d597fd`. The five unfinished runs are not verdicts yet: the landing waits for them to finish green.

### ② Semver level

- `skip-changeset` is right: the diff is `docs/adr/**` only, which no published package ships.
- Clause-②: the claim (6884480897, branch `claude/project-thread-6cr30t`) carries `Clause-②: no`, and that is right: nothing authorable narrows or widens. The PR body owes no `Clause-②:` line on a diff with no changeset; PR-body guards are green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 6889459761 (round 2): `open_questions` empty, `out_of_scope_findings` empty, no deviation flagged. Nothing to answer.
- The report and the PR body name #33656 as the code fix that will drop the qualifier. #33656 is open and says what finding 1 of 6889382518 found. Right; the line must be revisited when it lands (noted, not a finding).
- Carried over from 6889382518, still for the seat and not a contract finding: the PR body says `Fixes #33301` while the seat's reopen note (6889216860) says the card closes only after this PR and PR #33642 both merge.

### ④ Design judgment

File judged: the ADR line, against `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts`, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts`, read on `origin/main` `3c0033f9`.

**The should-fix of 6889382518 (install-local names one id): fixed, truthfully.**

- "a hot install-local install or upgrade, for the package the door announces (...) ... carried at once": holds. The door announces once, `changed: ['app/' + manifestId]` (`announceHotInstall`, :3269 and :6805), where `manifestId` is the delivered artifact's parsed `manifest.id` (:2488). `positionRenameReloadScope` (:533-555) admits it while the registry holds that package, and the run judges only the claims whose holder is in scope (:588-589).
- "the other packages of a multi-package artifact, which install-local registers but does not name ... are carried at the next restart": holds, both halves. Registers: the door hands the whole artifact to the `manifest` service (:3140), whose `register` resolves every `packages[]` entry (`resolveArtifactPackageEntries`, `artifact-packages.ts` :308) and calls `ql.registerApp(manifest, ...)` once per entry, each under its own id, in one restore run (`objectql/src/plugin.ts` :942-943, :1046-1047). Does not name: no second announce exists in the door (two `metadata:reloaded` call sites in the file, the install at :6805 and the uninstall at :3817, each with the one id). Next restart: the rehydrate re-registers the ledgered artifact inside `kernel:ready` and the boot run at `kernel:bootstrapped` (`kernel.ts` :619, :632) judges every claim.
- Tried and not broken: the qualifier does not take away what round 1 accepted (a single-package upgrade is the announced package, pinned by `marketplace-install-local-hot-resync.test.ts` :304). A member that carries the artifact's own id is the announced package and is carried at once, as the item says. A member announced later by another door (an enable of a disabled member, a per-item publish of its position) is carried then, which the same list already states for those doors.

**Nit 2 of 6889382518 (the disabled claimant): fixed, truthfully.**

- "nor carries holders onto a claimant whose package is disabled (refused `claimant-disabled` ...)": holds. A claim whose position belongs to a disabled package is read from the registry with `disabled: true` (`disabledPackagePositions`, :326; :580) and refused `claimant-disabled` (:645-647) on the boot run and on a reload run alike. Pinned: `position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts` :339.
- "... until an enable announces the package": holds for every door that enables. `PATCH /packages/:id/enable` announces only when the package was disabled before the switch (`wasDisabled`, `packages.ts` :2875, :2883), and a disabled claimant's package is exactly that case, so the conditional never bites here; an enable of an already-enabled package announces nothing and has nothing to carry (pinned, `packages-reload-announce.test.ts` :205). The other enabling door, an overwrite `POST /packages` with `enableOnInstall: true`, calls `registry.enablePackage` (:2726) and then announces `app/ID` unconditionally (:2808), so it is also "an enable [that] announces the package". Both are pinned on a real kernel: `packages-reload-announce.test.ts` :186 and :223. `registry.enablePackage` (`registry.ts` :11041) has no third HTTP caller; the in-process install primitive (`protocol-package-install.ts` :461) is reached with `enableOnInstall` by no door on `main`.
- The disable announcement (#33546, `packages.ts` :2958) names a package the registry still holds, so the run judges its claims and refuses each `claimant-disabled`. It moves nothing and does not contradict "until an enable".
- With this sentence in, the "carried at once" items read correctly for a package that is disabled when announced (an install that lands disabled, an install-local upgrade that keeps the row disabled): the refusals sentence now excepts it.

**The rest of the line, re-read sentence by sentence on `main`:** unchanged from 6889382518 and still holds: the two run points and "as the system, in every organization"; the refusal set (`claimed-twice`, `still-declared`, `held-by-other`, `owned-by-other`, `switched-off`, :624-657); "carried for its one claimant"; "the packages this boot loaded"; the scope spelling (`app/ID` while held, `position/NAME`); `POST /packages` (:2808); the enable that switches a disabled package on (:2883); the per-item publish and publish-drafts; the artifact reload that names only its file; "named in the log of the run ... never rewritten"; "nothing is carried back on a downgrade". No new false claim found.

Findings:

1. **nit** — "until an enable announces the package" names one of two ends. The boot run also carries the claim once the package is enabled: when the enable's announce fails (`announcePackageReload` logs and says "restart the process", `packages.ts` :971-984), or when the stored package state changes between boots. The line's own next sentences say the carry "runs at boot over every claim", and the warning the code prints for this refusal names the boot (:688; PR #33642 makes it name both). Not false, slightly narrow. Accepted deviation, or one word on a later prose pass ("until an enable announces the package, or the next boot after it").
2. **nit** — the parenthetical names the reason a disabled claimant gets when nothing earlier refuses it. A disabled claimant whose old name two positions claim, or a position still declares, is refused `claimed-twice`, `still-declared` or `held-by-other` first (:624-643). The holders are not carried either way, so the sentence's claim stands. Accepted deviation.
3. **nit** — "the other packages of a multi-package artifact" assumes one member is the announced package. When no member carries the artifact's own id (the door's own note, :2566-2570), the door announces no held package and every member waits for the boot. The line's rule before the colon (`app/ID` while the registry holds package `ID`) covers it, and the conclusion (carried at the next restart) is the right one for all of them. Related, read but not traced end to end: a multi-package artifact's residual top-level items register under the artifact's own id with no package row (`objectql/src/plugin.ts` :1062-1071, :1083), so a residual position's claim would wait for the boot too in that same case. Both go away with #33656 if it announces every delivered id. Accepted deviation.
4. **nit** — prose: "It does not carry ..., nor carries holders onto ..." wants "nor does it carry". No effect on the contract.
5. **nit** — carried over, unchanged, from 6889382518 nit 3: `logPositionRenameCarry` does not repeat a warning identical to one the run before said (:710), so "named in the log of the run" has that one exception on the reload path. Accepted deviation.

Read, not reviewed (outside the diff), as in 6889382518: on `main` the spec describe (`position.zod.ts` :166-171), its generated row, the carry's module doc (:135-141) and `REFUSAL_SENTENCE['claimant-disabled']` (:688) still say the runtime install and enable routes do not announce and that the first boot after the enable carries. PR #33642 corrects them; its text owes the same "for the package the door announces" qualifier until #33656 lands.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-6cr30t`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5mswnWm181XgYcCUag`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## ACCEPT · PR #33653 (#33301 ADR 小修，Tier H) · head `1bb25336ec432a8d7e64303fa10e6082cb205f56` · 2026-11-15T05:41Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只改 ADR-0150 第 288 行（2026-11-13 补遗）：职位改名后的持有人迁移，"仍在服务的版本上热升级"从"下次重启"改为"立即迁移"（#33050 起重注册会撤回旧职位）；install-local 的"立即迁移"只对它广播的那个包成立，多包制品的其它包要等下次重启；补上"停用包的认领方被拒绝（`claimant-disabled`），直到启用时广播再迁移"。
- **为什么改**：#33568 合入后，#33473 用真实内核测试钉住了热升级立即迁移，原句已不实；复审又发现 install-local 只广播制品自身 id。
- **风险与回滚**：纯 ADR 文字，一行 +1/-1，无代码、无发布内容。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md` 第 288 行。
- **两分钟验证**：对照 `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `announceHotInstall`（只发 `app/<manifestId>`）与 `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts` 的 `claimant-disabled`。
- **需要你做的**：审阅并批准。契约复审 PASS 记录 6889535113（delta，前轮 6889382518），Head-sha `1bb25336ec432a8d7e64303fa10e6082cb205f56`。批准后由席位落地。
- **席位意见**：建议批准。这是 #33568 之后同一行的第二次校正，两轮复审逐句对照 main 现码；剩余均为 nit。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** 1 file（`docs/adr/0150-…md`），+1/-1，全部 Tier H；`skip-changeset` 正确，`Clause-②: no`。
- **前提实测:** 席位读 origin/main：install-local 只发 `app/<manifestId>`；`replacingPackageBody`（#33050）在重注册时撤回旧职位，#33473 真实内核测试钉住；`claimant-disabled` 在启动与重载两种运行里都拒绝。
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `1bb25336` 上 49 项：27 success、22 skipped，无失败。
- **契约复审:** 第一轮 PASS 带一个 should-fix（6889382518，install-local 只点名一个 id），delta PASS 6889535113 确认已如实修正，nit 2 一并修正。
- **接受的偏差:** delta 复审的 5 个 nit：启用之后的那次启动同样会迁移；停用认领方可能先被其它拒绝原因挡下；"其它包"预设某个成员带制品 id；一处措辞；日志去重（前轮 nit 3）。均不影响正确性。
- **范围外去向:** install-local 对多包制品每个成员都广播 → #33656（server 车道，p3；p3 已停派，留队列）。该卡落地时须同时撤掉此处与 spec 文字里的限定语。
- **落地条款:** Tier H ⇒ 挂 `pm:awaiting-merge`、翻 ready 并请 GOVERNED_APPROVER 审批；获批后席位落地。PR 写 `Fixes #33301`，#33642（Refs #33301）预计先合；若本 PR 先合，卡会再次自动关闭，席位届时再处理。
